title: Thin Ice
intro: You are about to watch a short film, shot by shot. It takes place on a frozen lake in winter.
style: Cinematic film still, 35mm film, cold blue winter light, snowy landscape, realistic, high detail.

characters.man: a young man in a bright yellow jacket and a red wool hat

s1_establish.prompt: Wide establishing shot of a vast frozen lake surrounded by snowy pine forest. {man} walks onto the ice carrying ice skates, smiling.
s1_establish.description: Wide shot of a frozen lake surrounded by snowy forest. A young man in a yellow jacket walks onto the ice carrying skates, smiling.

s2_reveal.prompt: Low close-up of the ice surface of a frozen lake: a long dark crack spreading across thin ice with dark water seeping through, and a small red warning sign reading DANGER THIN ICE half buried in snow.
s2_reveal.description: Close-up of the ice: a long crack spreads across thin ice with water seeping through, next to a red 'DANGER THIN ICE' sign.

s2_filler.prompt: Low close-up of the ice surface of a frozen lake: smooth thick white ice covered with fresh powder snow and old skate marks.
s2_filler.description: Close-up of the ice: smooth thick white ice with fresh snow and skate marks.

s3_skate.prompt: Medium shot of {man} skating gracefully in wide circles on a frozen lake, arms spread, laughing.
s3_skate.description: Medium shot: the young man skates gracefully in circles, laughing.

s4_center.prompt: Wide shot of {man} skating fast toward the center of a huge frozen lake, waving happily at the camera.
s4_center.description: Wide shot: the young man skates toward the center of the lake, waving happily.

s5_blades.prompt: Extreme low close-up of ice skate blades gliding and scraping across the frozen lake surface, ice shavings spraying.
s5_blades.description: Extreme close-up: skate blades glide across the ice surface.

s6_break.prompt: Wide shot: the ice suddenly breaks beneath {man} on a frozen lake and he plunges into the freezing dark water with a big splash.
s6_break.description: The ice suddenly breaks and the young man plunges into the freezing water.

questions.text: Based only on what you have seen so far, how do you think this scene will end?

options.calm: He enjoys skating and goes home safely; nothing bad happens.
options.escape: Something dangerous happens, but he gets away unharmed.
options.harm: Something dangerous happens and he gets hurt.

probe_facts.question: Is there a visible crack in the ice or a thin-ice warning sign in this shot?
Is a person falling through the ice into the water in this shot?
